meta.name: canvas
meta.description: Display and control HTML content on connected Bitterbot nodes (Mac, iOS, Android) via the canvas host server. Use when presenting games, visualizations, dashboards, or interactive demos on a connected device, navigating canvas URLs, capturing canvas snapshots, or debugging canvas connectivity.

copy.tagline: 在连接设备上展示并控制HTML内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多设备上展示或调试HTML页面
copy.tagline_en: Display and control HTML content on connected devices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to present or debug HTML pages on multiple devices

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以在连接的 Bitterbot 节点（Mac、iOS、Android）上显示和控制 HTML 内容，例如游戏、可视化、仪表盘或交互式演示。
howto.when: 当你想在连接的设备上展示网页内容、导航画布 URL、捕获画布截图或调试画布连接时触发。

say.text: 在 Mac 节点上显示 snake.html 画布。

say.note: Claude 会执行 hide 动作，关闭画布视图。
Claude 会执行 snapshot 动作，返回截图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can display and control HTML content on connected Bitterbot nodes (Mac, iOS, Android), such as games, visualizations, dashboards, or interactive demos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to present web content on a connected device, navigate canvas URLs, capture canvas snapshots, or debug canvas connectivity.

say_en.text: Show snake.html canvas on the Mac node.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the present action on that node.
Claude will execute the hide action.

say_en.text: Take a snapshot of the canvas.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the snapshot action and return the image.
